guide_solution: (a) If we invest in girls education we will get good returns. (b) Educating girls is not a waste. (c) Educated girls have higher income potential than those who are uneducated and unskilled. (d) Also, educated mothers are very careful in ensuring quality education for their children. (e) Therefore, we should try our best to educate our girls.
